When EchoLedger can\'t hear the phone line (a Galaxy keeps it for its own Phone app), let the Phone app record each call. EchoLedger brings each recording in right after the call, named after the contact or the number.

Only calls you asked EchoLedger to record, and only files the Phone app made during the call. When EchoLedger heard the call itself, its own recording is kept.
